reasons.action: The only supplied asset is an audio voice-timbre reference, which carries no depicted pose or scene action. The intent 'the man speaks in the corridor' is therefore entirely request-governed.
reasons.medium: There is no visual reference; the sole reference is a voice-timbre audio clip that cannot establish a rendering medium, and the request names no visual medium or transformation. Medium therefore defaults to the request-governed Live-action, cinematic.
reasons.wardrobe: No visual reference and no wardrobe description in the request or director notes, so wardrobe is left to the request/scene direction.
reasons.lighting: The audio reference supplies no lighting information, and the request specifies none, so lighting is request-governed.
reasons.framing: The 16:9 aspect and 8-second duration are canvas and timing configuration, not framing instructions; with no visual reference, framing remains request-governed.
reasons.palette: Neither the audio reference nor the brief specifies a palette, so palette is request-governed.
